children: HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (NSE:HDFCBANK) named Anup Bagchi as MD & CEO with a ₹35.90cr pay package and shareholder vote set, as strong deposit inflows and overseas funding lift advances and analyst Buy ratings despite near‑term NIM pressure and eased valuations.
Previous Week Recap
HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR: Anup Bagchi Appointment
: HDFCBANK appoints Anup Bagchi as MD & CEO from Oct 27, 2026. Proposed pay ₹35.90 crore (₹8.97 cr fixed, ₹26.92 cr variable) plus ₹7.35 cr one‑time stock bonus; shareholder vote planned
HDFC Bank Deposits Rise; Advances Grow
: HDFCBANK Q2: deposits +18.8–19% to ~Rs33.3T; gross advances ~+16.3% to ~Rs32.2T. Much deposit accretion driven by FCNR(B) inflows; adjusted organic growth lower; CASA softer.
HDFC Bank NIM Pressure Anticipated
: HDFCBANK traders: analysts expect near-term net interest margin drop of 5–10 bps, and 8–20 bps decline by 2QFY27, citing FCNR(B) inflows, liquidity and rapid balance-sheet growth.
RBI Hike Could Reprice NIMs
: A 25bp RBI repo hike to 5.50% could speed repricing of HDFCBANK's floating retail and MSME loans, potentially widening NIMs ~6–10bps and boosting EPS ~3–5%; valuations have eased this year.
HDFC Bank ADR FCNR(B) Funding
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK) raised $11.5B in FCNR(B) deposits (June–Aug 2026); overseas branches extended $5.7B in loans, $3.1B in standby LOCs, and issued $2.5B in USD bonds.
Analysts Keep Buy On ADR
: Analyst houses keep Buy/Overweight on HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK) with price targets ₹970–₹1,050, citing new leadership and steady core growth—key details for traders: ratings and target range.
RBI Approves Pay Package
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK) got RBI approval for its pay package. Shareholders will vote by postal ballot electronically from Oct 8 to Nov 6, 2026.
NII Growth Seen By Motilal Oswal
: Motilal Oswal sees HDFC Bank (HDFCBANK) NII rising about 8.9% YoY in 2QFY27, highlighting its contribution to sector earnings momentum.
Bagchi Appointment, Buy Ratings Retained

: HDFCBANK named Bagchi, resolving a leadership overhang. Analysts kept Buy ratings with targets ~Rs925–950, citing expected better operating performance, loan growth and margins under new leadership.
ADR Dominates Margin Trading Exposure
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK) was the largest stock by margin trading facility exposure in September, topping the list of equities held in leveraged trader positions.
